grain: One row per MCH-related tender (unique Tender ID), with the bid listed at the results stage.

largest_awarded_tender.title: Mother and Child Hospital (500 bedded) at GMCH, Guwahati, SOPD-ODS

quirks.text: 'Awarded Value' is filled for rejected and not-admitted bids too. Summing all rows overstates spending by ~₹58.7 crore. Use awarded_amount_inr (is_awarded only).

19 awarded tenders, almost all goods or item-rate drug/equipment contracts, record a placeholder or unit rate instead of the contract value: ₹0 (7), ₹1 (5, e.g. a JE vaccine tender estimated at ₹10 crore), ₹375 per Samahar kit. Spending on goods, and by Health and Family Welfare, is therefore badly understated. Flag: awarded_value_suspect in the view. Report these tenders separately, and use tender_value_inr as the estimate where it exists.
One ₹214 crore GMCH hospital tender is ~80% of awarded value. Say so in any total, trend or Kamrup Metro answer; offer a view without it.
'Tender Value in ₹' is text like '2,06,34,54,000'. Values are rupees, not lakh or crore.
Title says 2019 to 2025, but 10 tenders were published in Dec 2017 or 2018; the range is the results period.
'month' is the results batch, close to the contract month, not the publication month.
Source has calendar dates only. Government readers often expect fiscal years (Apr to Mar); contract_fiscal_year in the view provides it.
13 tenders not geotagged (NA) and 3 CONFLICT. District totals do not add up to the state total.
'SIVSAGAR' here vs 'SIVASAGAR' in the boundary file; normalised in the view.
Scheme holds several codes separated by ';'. Counting per scheme double counts tenders across schemes.
CHD_SCHEME (6 tenders) comes from the office name 'Director Cum CHD - PWD BTC', not the Congenital Heart Disease scheme.
Bodoland Territorial Council appears as both 'Bodoland Territorial Council' and 'Bodoland Territorial Council-PWD' at the top level.
Most districts have 1 to 3 tenders and most months have 1 to 5. Avoid rankings or % change on such small numbers.
Only tenders published on the portal (the use case cites ~20% of all tenders). Absence of tenders in a district does not mean absence of spending.
pandas reads the string 'NA' as missing by default (DISTRICT_FINALISED, Pre Bid Meeting Date). Load with keep_default_na=False or use the view.

joins.district: Joins to data-ecosystem/maps/Geojson/assam_district_2024-11.geojson on dtname, and to district-level outcome data (IMR, NFHS-5, HMIS) after name normalisation. Cross-dataset: not in v1.

columns.name: Tender ID
columns.description: Portal tender ID, e.g. '2023_NHM_34072_1' (year_issuer_number_part). Unique per row.

columns.name: tender_externalreference
columns.description: Issuer's own reference number. Not unique: several tenders can share one.

columns.name: tender_title
columns.description: Tender title as published. Some BTC titles are just codes like 'TN_217_D'.

Construction of New Labour Room cum Maternity Ward at Gurufela Subsidiary Health Centre of Kachugaon Minority Concentrated Block, under cent

columns.name: Work Description
columns.description: Work description; often the same as the title, sometimes cut off.

examples: Construction of New Labour Room cum Maternity Ward at Kamalsing Subsidiary Health Centre of Kachugaon Minority Concentrated Block, under cen
Construction of New Labour Room cum Maternity Ward at Kachugaon Block Primary Health Centre of Kachugaon Minority Concentrated Block, under

columns.name: Tender Category
columns.description: Works, Goods or Services.

columns.name: Tender Type
columns.description: Open Tender, Open Limited, Limited or Single.

columns.name: Form of contract
columns.description: Item Rate, Item Wise, Supply, Buy, Turn-key, Works, Fixed-rate.

columns.name: Product Category
columns.description: Portal product category (Civil Works, Medicines, Medical Equipments/Waste...).

columns.name: Is Multi Currency Allowed For BOQ
columns.description: Always 'No'. Not useful.

columns.name: Allow Two Stage Bidding
columns.description: Always 'No'. Not useful.

columns.name: Independent External Monitor/Remarks
columns.description: Always 'NA'. Not useful.

columns.name: Published Date
columns.description: Publication timestamp, format '02-Feb-2018 04:30 PM'.

columns.name: Pre Bid Meeting Date
columns.description: Pre-bid meeting timestamp; mostly 'NA'.

columns.name: Bid Validity(Days)
columns.description: Bid validity period.

columns.name: Should Allow NDA Tender
columns.description: Always 'No'. Not useful.

columns.name: Allow Preferential Bidder
columns.description: Always 'No'. Not useful.

columns.name: Payment Mode
columns.description: Online, Offline or Not Applicable (fee payment).

columns.name: Bid Opening Date
columns.description: Bid opening timestamp, same format as Published Date.

columns.name: Organisation Chain
columns.description: Issuing organisation hierarchy, '||'-separated. Same as Department in this file.

examples: Bodoland Territorial Council-PWD||Director Cum CHD - PWD BTC
Public Works Building and NH Department||Chief Engineer-Building - PWBNH

columns.name: location
columns.description: Free-text work location from the portal (town, facility or district). One input to geotagging.

columns.name: Pincode
columns.description: Work-location PIN code as entered by the issuer (read as float in pandas, e.g. 783370.0).

columns.name: No of Bids Received
columns.description: Number of bids received (1 or 2 in this file).

columns.name: Tender Value in ₹
columns.description: Estimated tender value at publication. String with Indian digit grouping ('2,06,34,54,000'); strip commas.

columns.name: Bidder Name
columns.description: Name of the bidder in this row. Can be an individual's name.

columns.name: Awarded Value
columns.description: Value of the bid in this row. Filled for rejected bids too, so only counts as spending when is_awarded is true (use awarded_amount_inr). For many goods / item-rate contracts it is a placeholder (0, 1) or a unit rate (awarded_value_suspect).

columns.name: Status
columns.description: Result for the listed bid: Accepted-AOC, Rejected-AOC, Not Admitted-Fee/PreQual/Technical, Rejected-Finance, Rejected-Technical.

columns.name: Contract Date :
columns.description: Contract date, format '07-Mar-2019'. Header has a trailing ' :'.

columns.name: Tender Stage
columns.description: 'AOC' or blank.

columns.name: Department
columns.description: Issuing department chain, '||'-separated. department_top in the view is the first segment.

examples: Bodoland Territorial Council-PWD||Director Cum CHD - PWD BTC
Public Works Building and NH Department||Chief Engineer-Building - PWBNH

columns.name: negative_keywords_dict
columns.description: Python dict literal of veterinary-term hit counts; all zero in this file.

columns.name: Scheme
columns.description: ';'-separated scheme codes (see glossary.json). Use the mch_tender_schemes view to count by scheme.

columns.name: is_awarded
columns.description: Status is an award status. Use as the filter for spending.

columns.name: is_mch_broad
columns.description: Passed the broad MCH rule; always True because the file is filtered on it.

columns.name: month
columns.description: Results batch the tender was scraped from. Matches the contract-date month for 93% of rows. Use for year or month trends.

columns.name: tender_district_externalReference
columns.description: District guessed from the reference number. Empty for every row.

columns.name: tender_district_title_description
columns.description: District guessed from title and description text.

columns.name: tender_district_location
columns.description: District guessed from the location field.

columns.name: BTC_flag
columns.description: Tender issued by a Bodoland Territorial Council body.

columns.name: DISTRICT_FINALISED
columns.description: Final district. 'NA' = not geotagged, 'CONFLICT' = sources disagree; both become NULL in the view (see district_geotag_status). 'SIVSAGAR' becomes 'SIVASAGAR'.
